asset_allocation_history.format_clue: Section headers within the 'PORTFOLIO STATEMENT' provide a high-level breakdown by asset class with percentages for the current and prior year-end.

geographic_allocation_history.format_clue: Sub-headers within the 'EQUITIES' section of the 'PORTFOLIO STATEMENT' provide a geographic breakdown for the equity portion of the portfolio, with percentages for the current and prior year-end.

portfolio_metrics.format_clue: A dedicated 'Benchmarks' section (p.31) lists the target and comparator benchmarks. A narrative mention of average duration is in the Investment Manager's Report (p.33). Portfolio dealing spread is in Note 16 (p.62). No explicit data for Top 10 concentration, number of holdings, or risk metrics like Sharpe/volatility.
portfolio_metrics.evidence_quote:
The Fund’s target benchmark is the UK Retail Prices Index.
The Fund’s comparator benchmarks are the UK Official Bank Rate and the FTSE All-Share Index (Total Return).

manager_qualitative.format_clue: Narrative paragraphs under the 'Investment Objective and Policy' section.
manager_qualitative.evidence_quote:
The investment objective of the Trojan Fund (‘the Fund’) is to seek to achieve growth in capital (net of fees), ahead of inflation (UK Retail Prices Index), over the longer term (5 to 7 years).
Capital invested is at risk and there is no guarantee that a positive return will be delivered or that the investment objective will be achieved.
